program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u053/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 5), None)
    # The background is the most common color; every aligned marker pair
    # paints the intervening background cells with color 3.
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(markers):
        for r2, c2 in markers[i + 1:]:
            if r1 == r2:
                for c in range(min(c1, c2) + 1, max(c1, c2)):
                    if grid[r1][c] == background:
                        out[r1][c] = 3
            elif c1 == c2:
                for r in range(min(r1, r2) + 1, max(r1, r2)):
                    if grid[r][c1] == background:
                        out[r][c1] = 3
    return out
'''
# marker color 9/4/7; use non-background cells, and background determined from mode.
p=program_dir/'task-1ed73a5b.py'
p.write_text(source)
